# computesphere_team (Resource)

Manages a team resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    computesphere = {
      source  = "computesphere/computesphere"
      version = "~> 1.1"
    }
  }
}

variable "api_token" {
  description = "API token for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "account_id" {
  description = "Account ID for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
}

variable "api_url" {
  description = "API URL for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
  default     = "api.computesphere.com"
}

provider "computesphere" {
  api_token  = var.api_token  # or set COMPUTESPHERE_API_TOKEN env variable
  account_id = var.account_id # or set COMPUTESPHERE_ACCOUNT_ID env variable
  api_url    = var.api_url    # or set COMPUTESPHERE_API_URL env variable
}

# Example: computesphere_team

resource "computesphere_team" "example" {
  name = "example-team"
  # account_id  = "your-account-id"
  description = "A sample ComputeSphere team created via Terraform"
  # Add other required or optional fields as needed
}

output "team_id" {
  value = computesphere_team.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the team.

### Optional

- `account_id` (String) The ComputeSphere account ID. Defaults to the provider account_id if not set.
- `description` (String) Description of the team.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp of the team.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the team.
- `updated_at` (String) Last updated timestamp of the team.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = computesphere_team.example
  identity = { id = "b7e6a1c2-3f4d-4e5a-8b9c-1d2e3f4a5b6c" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String)

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = computesphere_team.example
  id = "b7e6a1c2-3f4d-4e5a-8b9c-1d2e3f4a5b6c"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a team by its ID
terraform import computesphere_team.example b7e6a1c2-3f4d-4e5a-8b9c-1d2e3f4a5b6c
```
